about_the_game:
Vulcard, the god of the volcano, is angry. As the two strongest warriors, your mission is to ascend the volcano and follow the ancient tradition to bring an offering to the god himself. In this two-player, time-based, roguelike deckbuilder, you have to collaborate to survive! Choose between different characters with distinct starting decks and unique abilities to fight your way up. Build your deck, meet curious characters, face countless enemies, experience intense boss fights and earn epic rewards! Can you return peace to the island?

Features

  • Real time card battling

  • Five characters to choose from.

  • 110+ cards to assemble your deck.

  • 50+ different enemies.

  • And more to come

FAQ

Do we need two copied of the game to play together?

No. You can either play together locally on the same machine or online using Remote Play Together. In both cases you only need one copy of the game.

Can I play this game alone?

Yes. While the game is intended as a two player game, you can control both characters at once on the same keyboard.

What sets Vulcard apart from other roguelike deckbuilders?

Vulcard is to our knowledge the only roguelike deckbuilder that uses time based combat. This means that enemies don't just wait for you to end your turn and instead regularly attack you, forcing you to make quick decisions. This makes Vulcard a fast-paced and action packed card battling game.
